_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score has moved ±2+ in only 3% of windows and no breaker is visible with neutral funding and no fresh ETF bid, making HOLD the statistically honest call despite the narrative's bullish lean.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD respecting coil base rates; narrative implies directional breakout. Judge sides with analyst's HOLD based on higher trust weight and the analyst's own poor direction-accuracy track record warranting humility.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding turns sharply negative (<-0.05%) with spot holding $62K+ and VIX breaks below 15 — signals leveraged washout completing and transition toward Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC loses $60K with VIX spiking above 22 and ETF outflows accelerating — confirms dead-cat peak and pushes toward Capitulation
